描述_EN: there are lappet borders around the base and the shoulder and a key-fret border around the neck. the relief depicts taoist emblems and flowers, perhaps gardenias, on a ground of cloud scrolls. the bottle is a flattened ovoid form with a flared neck. the high stepped foot has a shallow curved indentation underneath. the flat upper surface of the neck-rim is gilded. it is made of porcelain, moulded in relief with a reticulated surface forming an outer casing over an inner body, and covered with red enamel in imitation of red lacquer. there is a conscious attempt to simulate the decorative motifs as well as the colour and techniques typical of lacquer carving. on the underside of the neck-rim and around the foot there is a line of dots.
描述_ZN: 底部和肩部有花边，颈部有匙形花边。 浮雕在云卷云舒的地面上描绘了道教的纹饰和花朵，也许是栀子花。 该瓶为扁平的卵圆形，颈部外扩的形式。 高台阶的脚下有一个浅浅的弧形压痕。 颈圈的平坦上表面是镀金的。 它是由瓷器制成的，以浮雕的方式铸造，表面是网状的，在内部形成一个外壳，并覆盖着仿红漆的红色珐琅。 有意识地尝试模拟装饰图案以及漆器雕刻的典型颜色和技术。 在颈部边缘的下方和脚部周围有一排小点。
